page.layout: One block of text: a centred heading "ORDO QVAESTIONVM." above a numbered list of six italic entries, each running in one or two lines. No running head, page number, catchword or signature. Small marginal numerals at the left of the entries are the list numbers, printed beside each entry.
page.notes: The numerals 1 to 6 at the left of the entries are partly damaged by a dark mark at the edge of the scan and are read from their shapes. The entry 6 has a dashed underline beneath "contra non" and "scriptas Traditiones", probably printed or marked decoration; not transcribed as text. Faint show-through of text from the other side is not transcribed.
